name: Nightwatchman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
designRole: One other player learns who the Nightwatchman is; creates a private confirmation link.
explanation: One other player learns who the Nightwatchman is; creates a private confirmation link.
